## Scope extension — maintainer calibration of 2026-09-13: the director seat runs the class-one gate on every inbox card BEFORE presenting, and a consumer aligning to the protocol never spawns a card that asks the protocol (director seat, 2026-09-13T06:58Z)

Maintainer, verbatim (live PM chat, 2026-09-13T07:0xZ), on decision batch #129 item 2 (objectui#9306, which the seat had presented with a proposed spec card):

> 「你是项目总监，9306 这种为什么你不直接决策呢？而且不是说要以协议为准吗？还需要立卡问 spec 多次一举啊。这个也需要更新skills。其他同意。」

This card already carries the ①-first self-check for the recommendation item. The same summon produced two more charter items; recorded here so one skills PR carries all three, ⛔ not three cards.

### Item 2 — the class-one gate is run on every inbox card before it is presented
`SKILL.md:400-403` already lets the summoned director seat self-adjudicate a card when the three criteria hold. What is missing is the ORDER: the charter should say the gate is applied to every `needs-user-decision` card as the first step of 决裁勤务, and a card that passes is ruled and recorded for the 追认表 — it never reaches a presented batch. objectui#9306 (route 2 = pull a consumer surface back to the protocol's declared set, `SKILL.md:395`) passed all three and was presented anyway; the maintainer's question 「9306 这种为什么你不直接决策呢？」 is the defect. Wording to land: 「决裁勤务第一步:逐卡过一类自裁三判据;全立者本席录裁不呈,只入收班追认表;呈报批只由二类/三类组成。」

### Item 3 — 「以协议为准」 means the protocol is the answer, not a question
A consumer surface (objectui type, dropdown, form, adapter) that diverges from the protocol's declared set is aligned to it; capabilities the protocol does not name are dropped, ⛔ not carried by a new spec card asking whether the protocol should gain them. A spec card is filed only when measured pull for the missing capability exists, and then it carries the pull. The seat's reflex on objectui#9306 (drop 4 dropdown ids → "file a spec card to ask") is the anti-pattern. Wording to land in `references/decision-analysis.md` beside the ①-first check: 「消费面对齐协议 ⇒ 一类自裁;协议没有的能力 ⇒ 删,⛔ 不立卡问协议;有实测拉动才立 spec 卡并附拉动。」

### Item 4 — an ADR item superseded by the protocol gets a dated amendment note, never a rewrite and never silence
From objectui#9223 (ADR-0055 item 5 records a precedence the spec's `objectNavTargetExclusivity` refuses): Prime Directive #13 keeps an accepted ADR binding, so the record form for "the protocol has since decided otherwise" is a dated amendment note under the item naming the superseding spec symbol / card — the ADR convention (MADR "superseded by"), and the only form that keeps both the history and the binding text honest. Wording to land in `references/core-rules.md`: 「ADR 条目被协议取代 ⇒ 条目下加带日期的修订注记点名取代它的 spec 符号/卡,⛔ 不改写原文、⛔ 不留作无注记的历史。」

⛔ Still no repo file written by the director seat. `pm:queue` / `domain:skills` / `priority:p2` unchanged.

## Addendum to item 3 — the maintainer's second sentence, 2026-09-13T07:0xZ, verbatim: 「协议就是答案，但是协议是否正确也是需要你考虑的，从平台长远合理性的角度考虑，并参考主流相关平台」

Item 3 is refined accordingly, ⛔ not reversed: 「以协议为准」 has two halves for the director seat. (i) Consumers align to the protocol, and no card is filed to *ask* the protocol. (ii) Whether the protocol itself is right is the seat's own axis-① judgment, made by READING the protocol and comparing it with mainstream platforms; where the protocol is found wrong, the seat rules the protocol change (or presents it when a floor is touched) — the spec card is then an execution card carrying the ruling, never a question. Wording to land: 「消费面对齐协议 ⇒ 一类自裁,⛔ 不立卡问协议;协议本身是否正确由本席按①读协议原文、参照主流平台判定 —— 判定协议有误 ⇒ 本席裁协议改动(触地板则呈),spec 卡承载裁决而非提问。」

The defect that produced this addendum is recorded as its own example: on objectui#9306 the seat ruled on a 14-member operator set copied from the card without opening `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:243`, where the protocol's set is 20 and already names every dropdown capability (amendment 5651809976 → see the card). Reading the protocol before ruling on it is the first step of the check, ⛔ not an optional one.

## Item 6 — a ruling exists only on its own card, in a fixed machine-readable header; nothing else counts as a ruling (from the #17306 misread, maintainer question 2026-09-13 「如何避免？」)

**What happened.** The `domain:spec` seat read a maintainer reply (「其他同意」, decision batch #129) that did not cover #17306, and doubted whether #17306 (ruled A′ in batch #130) had a letter. The ruling was on the card (5651909056) with the batch line and the verbatim reply, so the record was right; the seat read a chat phrase / ledger line instead of the card.

**Rule to land (three lines).**
1. **Only the card carries a ruling.** A seat acts on a decision-box outcome only when its own card carries a `## Ruling recorded` comment from the director seat. A maintainer phrase in any chat, a ledger row on a seat post, or a quote on another card is ⛔ not a ruling for this card — 「其他同意」 covers exactly the items of the batch line it answered, and that line is written on each card it covers.
2. **Fixed header line, first line of the ruling comment, one per card:** `Ruling: batch #<n> item <k> · letter <X> · maintainer 「<verbatim>」 <UTC>`. Batch, item, letter and the verbatim reply in one greppable line, so batch membership cannot be misread from prose.
3. **Claims cite the ruling.** When a seat claims or dispatches a card that came out of `needs-user-decision`, the `Claim:` block carries `Ruling-ref: <comment id>`; the half-state patrol flags a former decision card dispatched without one, and the referenced comment must be on the same card with the header above.

**Why this and not a broadcast.** Sending rulings to seats' chats creates a second channel that can disagree with the card; the card is the only place the director, the seat, triage and the maintainer all read. The header makes the one record unambiguous; the `Ruling-ref:` makes acting-without-a-record visible.

Director seat, 2026-09-13T07:42Z. ⛔ Still no repo file written by the director seat; the skills PR carrying items 1–5 carries this one too.
